# QA-A-205 — copy-site audit (generated by scratchpad/audit205.py from 01_copy_calls_raw.txt and 02_datasize_raw.txt)

Method A: every `memcpy`/`memmove`/`std::copy*`/`.assign(`/`.insert(`/`std::fill` call in `modules/preprocess/src` and `modules/common/src` (63 lines).
Method B: every use of `dataSize` in the same trees (48 lines).
Line numbers are those of commit 098ae75b, before the fix of this card.

## Cross-check: method B against method A

Method A's text filter on `dataSize` finds only the copies that spell `dataSize` in the call (`pipeline.cpp:139`, `calibration_cache.cpp:463`, `xpe_memory.cpp:81`). Method B finds the lines that FEED a copy length through a variable, which method A's text cannot see:

| method B line | feeds the copy at | verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `pipeline.cpp:312` `copySize = min(img->dataSize, ...)` | `pipeline.cpp:313` | bounded by both sizes; truncates silently (see verdict) |
| `calibration_cache.cpp:245` `bytes = entry.buffer.dataSize` | `:250` | checked against n*sizeof(T) at 246-247 |
| `calibration_cache.cpp:592,671,750` `staging.resize(desc.dataSize)` | `:593,672,751` | staging sized from the same value |
| `xpe_memory.cpp:78` | `:81` | dst->dataSize >= src->dataSize is the guard |
| `runtime_detection.cpp:94,100`, `xpe_calib_generate_nonlin_lut.cpp:96`, `xpe_calib_generate_offset_methods.cpp:94,414`, `xpe_defect_gen.cpp:464` | reads/writes sized by dims | each compares dataSize with what the dims need before use |
| `offset_correct.cpp:166,168`, `gain_correct.cpp:261,264`, `defect_correct.cpp:138,140` | the stage kernels | the #123 contract: 0 = unspecified, smaller is refused |

Every method-B line is either a producer of a size (`dataSize = ...`), a guard (`dataSize < ...`), or one of the copies above. The only caller-size-driven copy that was unguarded is `pipeline.cpp:139`.
